thread:
eva: Quick heads up — perf profiler on host-proxy spiked this morning. p95 decode for short requests went from ~40ms to ~120ms after last kernel-picker rollout.

Stack-ish sample from perf flame (top lines):

```
user  32%  tokenization::split -> parse::emit -> grpc::small_write -> syscall::write
kernel 18%  copy_from_user
```

Looks like tokenization + syscall churn (many small gRPC writes) + extra KV lookups are the main suspects. cc @karthik @ben for kernel-picker changes.

ben: Oof. I pushed the kernel-picker tweak yesterday to prefer the new micro-kernel for low-latency targets. I did microbench locally but maybe missed the small-req pattern. Can confirm seeing more small syscalls in traces.

karthik: I changed the picker to bias AVX path for batch sizes < 8 (thought this would help throughput). That could explain the tail for tiny requests — kernel has different instruction mix and interacts poorly with our current tokenizer prefetch.

anya: FWIW KV cache miss-rate jumped ~3x around the same window, so host ends up doing more lookups. Fragmented streams are causing prefix miss and we fall back to parsing full request which triggers extra tokenization CPU.

eva: Short term triage plan:
- coalesce small gRPC writes (writev) to cut syscall churn (ben?)
- canary revert kernel-picker for 10% traffic to see tail impact
- tweak batching heuristics so tiny requests use legacy kernel or mini-batch path
- bump KV prefix cache TTL + add prefetch on parse where safe

ben: I'll prototype a writev coalesce patch this morning. Local bench (simple microbench against bench-host):

```
baseline p95: 40ms
post-picker p95: 120ms
with writev-coalesce p95: 60ms
```

So coalescing helps a lot but doesn't fully recover baseline — suggests kernel selection + KV misses still matter.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary applied — routing 10% -> kernel_picker=legacy for service host-proxy @ 2026-03-23T15:35Z :rocket:

karthik: Good. I'll open a PR to add a mini-batcher path: detect short-seq (<64 tokens) and force mini-batch + legacy kernel, and add a soft max_wait=3ms for those to avoid latency amplification. Also will add a toggle so we can flip quickly.

anya: I'll add KV cache metrics to the runtime dashboard (prefix hit rate, prefetched keys/sec) and a perf regression test that runs tiny-request workload nightly. Also wiring an alert if p95 > 80ms for the tiny workload.

eva: Nice. Action items summarized:
- ben: PR for writev coalesce + bench numbers, run canary bench once patch is in
- karthik: PR for mini-batcher + picker toggle (and option to revert picker)
- anya: dashboards, alert, nightly perf test

Let's reconvene in ~2h with fresh numbers. If canary shows tail improvement we can roll further. :thumbsup:
